svg.title: PACE enclosure A: printable cover and concealed wall plate
svg.desc: CAD-derived views. The cover and wall plate attach with two headed studs, a 12 millimetre downward slide and one underside locking screw. Nominal wall-to-glass depth is 37.5 millimetres. Physical print and load checks are pending.
svg.text: PACE enclosure A / two printed parts
LCD-7 (27078) · existing front glass retained · PETG · dimensions in mm
188 × 147 mm footprint · 4 outer M3 display mounts
Integrated SHT40 cradle below the display; USB exits downward.
Two printed studs; one captive M3 nut in the bottom lug.
Mount: align → slide down 12 mm → secure underside screw
37.5 mm nominal wall-to-glass depth. Use the plate itself to mark the wall holes.
To remove: unplug, support display, remove lock screw, lift 12 mm and pull forward.
CAD fit checked against manufacturer models. Print, cable fit, load and thermal checks still required.
Not a drilling template. Follow hardware/enclosure.md for fasteners, orientation and assembly.
